title: Evaluation of Bias Towards Medical Professionals in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Creating fictitious medical candidate resumes and manipulating explicit gender information or using implicit gender-associated names, then prompting large language models to rank the candidates for various residency programs to evaluate differential selection rates.

Creating fictitious medical candidate resumes and manipulating explicit race information (Asian, Black, Hispanic, White) or using implicit race-associated names, then prompting large language models to rank the candidates to evaluate demographic preferences in residency selection.
